One pipeline run

Source: R/classes.R
punkstRun.Rd

The result of run_punkst_pipeline(): the exported transcripts file, the three stage objects, and where the data came from (needed by sdata_writeback() to align results with the source store).

Usage

punkstRun(transcripts, tiles, hex, model, source)

Arguments

transcripts

Path to the exported transcripts file.

tiles, hex, model

The punkstTiles, punkstHex and punkstModel stage objects.

source

List with sdata (store path), points_key and coordinate_system (as used for export; may be NULL).

Value

A punkstRun object.

Examples

tiles <- punkstTiles(workdir = tempdir(),
    files = list(tsv = "t.tsv", index = "t.index", features = "t.features.tsv"),
    params = list())
hex <- punkstHex(workdir = tempdir(),
    files = list(data = "hex.txt", meta = "hex.json"), params = list())
model <- punkstModel(workdir = tempdir(),
    files = list(model = "m.model.tsv", state = "m.state"), params = list())
run <- punkstRun(transcripts = "transcripts.tsv", tiles = tiles, hex = hex,
    model = model, source = list(sdata = "demo.zarr", points_key = "transcripts"))
run
#> <punkstRun>
#>   source     : demo.zarr 
#>   transcripts: transcripts.tsv 
#> <punkstTiles> in /tmp/Rtmp0mSydy
#>   tsv       t.tsv
#>   index     t.index
#>   features  t.features.tsv
#> <punkstHex> in /tmp/Rtmp0mSydy
#>   data      hex.txt
#>   meta      hex.json
#> <punkstModel> in /tmp/Rtmp0mSydy
#>   model     m.model.tsv
#>   state     m.state
